title: Polish landing hero flow and diagram
summary: Fixed the landing page command, rewrote the hero animation to avoid broken moving labels, and unified the plan-to-verifiable-change diagram styling. The hero now uses stable stacked cards with contained scan/focus motion, static callouts, and the documented install command from the repository.
userVisibleChange: The landing page now shows the correct install command, has a cleaner smooth hero animation without overlapping moving text, and presents a more unified step diagram with consistent icons and connector arrows.

risks.title: Long install command can be dense on mobile
risks.mitigation: Added responsive command font sizing and clipping controls so it stays inside the command box.

timeline.title: Locked landing polish plan
timeline.summary: Scoped the fix to site/app/page.tsx and site/app/global.css.

timeline.title: Fixed command, hero motion, and diagram
timeline.summary: Replaced the command, rebuilt hero animation around contained card motion, and changed step arrows/icons.

timeline.title: Verified build and browser views
timeline.summary: Ran production build, desktop/mobile screenshots, reduced-motion check, and console check.

decisions.title: Use the README install command in the hero
decisions.rationale: The repository root README documents `npx --yes @nhestrompia/eve@latest install` as the install command, so the landing hero should not advertise `npx eve init`.

decisions.title: Contain hero animation inside the card stack
decisions.rationale: Moving text chips could collide with the callout labels. A card scan/focus animation keeps the visual alive while preserving static readable labels.

decisions.title: Use CSS line arrows for the step diagram
decisions.rationale: Text arrows looked inconsistent and misaligned. Pseudo-element connector lines and arrowheads create a unified diagram style.

validation.output: Next.js production build compiled successfully, TypeScript passed, and 19 static pages generated.
Captured desktop screenshot; corrected command fits, hero callouts no longer collide with animated text, and step connectors/icons are unified.
